candidates.change_summary: Replace 'require(msg.value == 10 ether);' with 'require(msg.value == 11 ether);' to change the required payment.
Delete 'require(msg.value == 10 ether);' so that fallback no longer requires a specific payment amount.
Delete 'require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime);' so that the time restriction is removed.
